breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between the two specified time integration methods. The ground truth prompt correctly removed the contradictory instruction 'time_integration: Explicit forward Euler', leaving only the detailed 'Strang splitting' method. The agent, however, incorrectly merged the two conflicting instructions into a single nonsensical phrase: 'Implement Strang splitting time integration with explicit forward Euler'. This perpetuates the original error instead of correcting it.
